sample_mapping_evidence: Six study-scoped people and six conservative donor/material groups, one PBMC observation per code. Global identity overlap unresolved.

source_processing: Cell Ranger (version 5.0.0) from 10×Genomics was applied to process raw gene expression matrices from each sample’s sequencing data. The R package Seurat (version 4.0.0) was used to process the unique molecular identifier (UMI) counting matrix, which was then used for quality control, normalization, dimensional reduction, batch effect removal, clustering, and visualization. DecontX, a novel Bayesian approach, was applied to eliminate the contamination in individual cells. To exclude low-quality captures and eliminate the possibility of multiple captures, cells were filtered out according to the following criteria: (1) gene numbers less than 400, (2) gene numbers more than 6000, (3) UMI larger than 50000, (4) percentage of mitochondrial RNA UMIs more than 10%, (5) percentage of ribosome RNA UMIs more than 40%, and (6) percentage of contamination in each cell more than 20%. Subsequently, use the “Normalize Data” function in Seurat to normalize and count the library size. Elimination of batch effects between individuals was achieved by identifying anchors between individuals and passing them to the “IntegrateData” function.
Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every cell
source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original deposited matrix barcode rows are not extra cells or biological samples. Fixed500RNA gate before conversion; every original count and coordinate audited.
source_metadata.native_coverage_policy: Retain each deposited native RNA feature axis separately. TP10K and mitochondrial fractions use available native RNA counts/features; omitted genes remain unavailable, not zero filled. Gene-reference and condition effects can be confounded, especially the distinct healthy-control axis in GSE274381. No full-transcriptome-equivalent denominator or cross-reference-equivalent mitochondrial percentage inferred.

title: PBMCs, Renal irAEs, sample1
extract_protocol_ch1: Patients' blood  was collected on the first day of each hospitalization. Blood samples from the participates were collected into the EDTA anticoagulant tube for later management. Then PBMCs were separated on the day of blood collection, and Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation was used to isolate PBMCs. Cell viability was assessed by microscopic examination using Taipan blue staining. Finally, samples with more than 85% viability can be used to conduct single-cell RNA-seq libraries.

Single-cell RNA-seq libraries were generated using Chromium Single-Cell 3’ Library and Gel Bead Kit v2 (10×Genomics, Pleasanton, CA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Then, the libraries were read on  Illumina NovaSeq 6000 system.
